sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        bb=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in bb);r1=max(p[0] for p in bb)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in bb);c1=max(p[1] for p in bb)
        if r1<50 and n['pixels']>=8 and n['color'] in('R','b','N','M'):
            d[n['color']]=(r0,r1,c0,c1)
    tip=0
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        bb=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in bb);c1=max(p[1] for p in bb)
        if n['color'] in('w','g') and 18<=r0<=35 and min(p[1] for p in bb)>=16: tip=max(tip,c1)
    d['ropeTip']=tip
    return d
print("BEFORE",snap(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT'])
print("AFTER ",snap(current_frame))
print("result",last_action_result.get('board_changed'),last_action_result.get('level_completed'),last_action_result.get('done'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
